meta_description: Davies Plastering Specialist in Manchester. Expert internal and external plastering, skimming, and rendering. Free quotes, same-day callouts available.
hero_subhead: Cracked walls, damp patches, or roughcast rendering? We diagnose and fix it properly, first time.
services_heading: Complete Plastering Services Across Greater Manchester
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full interior skimming and external rendering—we handle all plastering work to trade standard.

services.title: Domestic Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Interior wall preparation, skimming, and finishing for a smooth, paintable surface. We make old walls look new and prepare new plasterboard fast.

services.title: Emergency Crack & Damage Repair
services.desc: Ceiling cracks, damp staining, and water damage patched and finished same day. We stop further deterioration and restore your wall to safe condition.

services.title: External Rendering & Roughcast
services.desc: Weather-resistant external finishes that protect your home and improve kerb appeal. We match existing render or upgrade to modern systems.

services.title: Artex Removal & Re-Skimming
services.desc: Strip old textured ceilings and replace with smooth plaster finish. Tidy, professional removal with full site cleanup included.

services.title: Plasterboard Installation & Taping
services.desc: Stud walls, partition walls, and ceiling boarding with seamless taping and jointing. Ready for decoration or tiling immediately.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Repairs
services.desc: Lime plaster restoration, heritage properties, and bespoke finishes. We work with period homes and tricky substrates that others avoid.

about_pullquote: I got into plastering because I hated seeing shoddy patch jobs. We do it right.
about_para_1: Davies Plastering Specialist has been serving Manchester homes and businesses for over 20 years. Started by a qualified plasterer fed up with poor-quality repairs on his own street, we've grown to a trusted team handling everything from small emergency cracks to full-house renovations. Every job is treated as though it's our own home—careful preparation, quality materials, and finishes that last.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on turning up on time, diagnosing problems properly, and leaving your home cleaner than we found it. We've built strong relationships with local builders, property managers, and homeowners because we listen to what you need and deliver without fuss or hidden costs. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and referrals—a sign that we get the job done right.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had massive cracks appearing in the lounge ceiling—was worried it was subsidence. John came out, explained it was just plaster movement, and skimmed the whole room beautifully. Looks perfect now and he even cleared up all the dust. Would definitely have him back.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: External render was peeling off in patches after the frost. Called on a Tuesday, they were here Wednesday morning and finished the same day. Quality work, reasonable price, and no mess left behind. Top marks.
reviews.author: Sandra L.

reviews.text: Nightmare with water damage on the ceiling from a roof leak upstairs. Not only did they repair and re-plaster it, they gave us advice on preventing it happening again. Very professional. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David C.
